name: Standout
description: Weekly AI/ML brief from papers and X. Chat only. Never edits.
about: Open a thread and say hi. Standout reads the last 7 days of AI/ML work and a fixed list of public X accounts, then returns one brief: papers, posts, and what is worth copying. It stays in the chat.
features: Summarize up to five impactful AI/ML papers
Read recent posts from fifteen X accounts
Cite what is worth copying this week
examplePrompt: What mattered in AI/ML this week, and what is worth copying?
